work.description: Configuration for the ACD (Acceptance-Criteria Development) work stream: the flat, chronological stream of milestone / story / task / uat items.

dir.description: Path, relative to the repo root, to the flat work-item stream (NN_type_slug folders).

agents.description: How ACD role agents are orchestrated.

mode.description: orchestrated = the main session spawns role sub-agents; solo = the main session performs every role inline.

productOwner.description: inline = the main session authors SPEC/story/acceptance; agent = delegate authoring to the aof-product-owner sub-agent.

delegation.description: The gpt-5.6 delegation toggle (default "off" when absent). off = Claude does everything itself and the codex-* skills render with disable-model-invocation:true (Claude Code won't auto-trigger them); on = the codex-* skills render auto-invocable so the ACD agents may hand bulk/mechanical work to gpt-5.6-sol via the Codex CLI when it is available. The init/update render honours this flag (applyDelegationToResources); flipping it re-renders the skills. Set with `aof work delegation on|off`.

models.description: Per-role model override map: an ACD role id (one of the 8 frozen roles, e.g. aof-architect) -> a model string (a moving family alias like "opus"/"sonnet", or a pinned id). Wins over the bundle's shipped default in the rendered agent file under orchestrated mode; inert (surfaced, not enforced) under mode "solo". Authoritative validation is `aof project validate` (no Ajv runs at validate time, so this schema is advisory): keys are checked against the live 8-role set derived from the bundle descriptor, and values must be non-empty and non-whitespace.

tags.description: Project-specific tag vocabulary (the closed set the validator enforces). Universal tags (@executable, @manual, @bug, @wip, @milestone-NN, @uat-<id>) are owned by the framework, not configured here.

ui.description: UI / design-review settings. ACD does NOT boot the app — the project runs it; ACD only points at it.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running app the design-conformance review renders surfaces against (e.g. https://localhost:1234); each DESIGN.md surface's Route is appended. Overridable per run with `aof:verify --url`.

a11y.description: OPTIONAL a11y lane config (milestone 07, ADR-004). Records the conformance LEVEL only; the lane opts IN via work.tags.domains containing the bare string "a11y" — NOT "@a11y"; it is deliberately the lone unprefixed domain token, so do not "normalise" it to an @-prefix or the opt-in silently breaks (no schema change to enable). Absent ≡ default/off. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.ui.baseUrl.

level.description: WCAG conformance level; default AA when the lane is on. Enum-only (the work.headroom.mode precedent — no separate type:string).

headroom.description: OPTIONAL headroom plugin config (milestone 06). Absent ≡ off — the work-board terminal launch is byte-for-byte unchanged when this block is absent or { enabled: false }. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.ui.

enabled.description: The master switch. An absent block OR enabled:false leaves the terminal launch unchanged (raw passthrough).

mode.description: wrap ONLY in v0; proxy is rejected at the schema (ADR-002 — a different runtime topology, not yet shipped). An enabled block with no mode defaults to wrap at runtime.

providers.description: OPTIONAL subset of routable providers to front; absent ⇒ both ["claude","codex"]. gemini is never a valid member (ADR-003 — not OpenAI-compatible, never routable).

doctor.description: OPTIONAL work-doctor health-lane config (milestone 15, ADR-003). Tunes the deterministic `work:doctor` cross-item checks. Absent ≡ defaults. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.headroom.

staleWindowDays.description: The freshness window in days: an in-progress item whose `updated` date is older than `now` by more than this is a `stale-updated` finding (milestone 15 story 02). Injected into the engine as a duration so freshness findings are deterministic in CI. Absent ⇒ 30 days.

budgets.description: OPTIONAL per-artifact line budgets for the work-doctor doc-bloat check (milestone 16). Each is the max line count before a `doc-over-budget` warn finding fires for that artifact kind. Absent keys ⇒ documented defaults (spec 300, architecture 700, story 150). Closed (additionalProperties:false).

spec.description: Max lines for a milestone SPEC.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 300.

architecture.description: Max lines for a milestone ARCHITECTURE.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 700 (ADR logs legitimately grow).

story.description: Max lines for a story STORY.md before doc-over-budget. Absent ⇒ 150.

roadmap.description: OPTIONAL structured milestone-index ROADMAP (milestone 15, ADR-004). When present and machine-parseable, the work-doctor `roadmap-folder-mismatch` cross-reference activates and diffs the indexed milestones against the on-disk folders. Absent ≡ honest no-op (a prose/backlog ROADMAP is NOT a structured index and never triggers the check). Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.doctor.

index.description: The structured milestone index: one entry per milestone the ROADMAP declares.

integrations.description: OPTIONAL external-integration config (milestone 17). Absent ≡ off — every aof work command behaves exactly as before; a present `notion` block opts the project into Notion work-board sync. Closed (additionalProperties:false), peer to work.doctor.

notion.description: OPTIONAL Notion work-board sync config (milestone 17, ADR-004; promoted to a multi-board registry in milestone 18, ADR-002). PRESENT ⇒ all binding lives here; ABSENT ⇒ `notion:sync-work` is an honest no-op. The token is NEVER committed here — only `tokenEnv`, the env-var NAME (RESEARCH §A2). The block is CLOSED (additionalProperties:false), so an unknown field (e.g. a `token`/`databaseId` field) is rejected. A `oneOf` of two MUTUALLY-EXCLUSIVE arms enforces the real shape: the FLAT m17 back-compat block (a top-level `dataSourceId` + connection fields, the implicit default board) OR the m18 `boards` registry (`{ default, boards }`). You cannot have both a top-level `dataSourceId` and a `boards` key. The `properties` below enumerate EVERY key either arm may carry (so the closed outer block admits both flat-arm and registry-arm keys); the AUTHORITATIVE per-arm validation (each arm's required fields, per-arm closedness, mutual exclusion) is the `oneOf`. The cross-check that `default` names a real board is NOT expressible in plain JSON-Schema — it lives in the resolver (src/integrations/routing.mjs), which fails with `unknown-default-board`.

dataSourceId.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The Notion data_source_id the milestone + its story sub-tasks live in.

tokenEnv.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The NAME of the env var the integration token is read from at run time. The token itself is NEVER stored in config — this is the env-var reference only.

statusProperty.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The board's status/select property name the aof status maps onto.

statusType.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The Notion TYPE of `statusProperty` — `status` (default) or `select` — so the egress writes the right property body shape.

statusMap.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The closed four-status map.

titleProperty.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The NAME of the data-source's title property the milestone/story title is written to (Notion's default is "Name"; a board may name it e.g. "Objective").

relationProperty.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The board's self-relation property name.

parents.description: (Flat-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[0]`.) The optional milestone→parent map.

default.description: (Registry-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[1]`.) The STRING key naming the default board.

boards.description: (Registry-arm key — authoritative shape in `oneOf[1]`.) The per-board registry.

oneOf.description: The FLAT milestone-17 back-compat arm: a single board's connection at the top level (the implicit default board, ADR-002). Closed (additionalProperties:false), so an unknown field (e.g. a `token`/`databaseId` field) is rejected. m17 configs validate byte-for-byte against this arm.

dataSourceId.description: The Notion data_source_id the milestone + its story sub-tasks live in (RESEARCH §A7 — NOT a bare database_id; the 2025-09-03 API routes query/create through the data source).

tokenEnv.description: The NAME of the env var the integration token is read from at run time (RESEARCH §A2). The token itself is NEVER stored in config — this is the env-var reference only.

statusProperty.description: The board's status/select property name the aof status maps onto.

statusType.description: The Notion TYPE of `statusProperty` — `status` (default) or `select` — so the egress writes the right property body (`{ status: { name } }` vs `{ select: { name } }`). aof never reads it from Notion (one-way), so it is configured here.

titleProperty.description: The NAME of the data-source's title property the milestone/story title is written to. Notion's default title property is "Name"; a board may name it anything (e.g. "Objective"). Optional — defaults to "Name".

statusMap.description: MANDATORY map (RESEARCH §A4): each of the four aof statuses → an EXISTING board option NAME. All four entries are required — `in-review` has no Notion default, so the operator MUST supply it. Closed (additionalProperties:false).

not-started.description: The board option name for the aof `not-started` status.

in-progress.description: The board option name for the aof `in-progress` status.

in-review.description: The board option name for the aof `in-review` status (no Notion default — must be supplied).

done.description: The board option name for the aof `done` status.

relationProperty.description: The board's self-relation property name a story sub-task is linked to its milestone page through (RESEARCH §A3).

parents.description: OPTIONAL milestone→parent map (milestone 18, ADR-001). Each entry maps a human-readable parent KEY (the value of a descriptor's `notion.parent`) to an EXISTING Notion parent page id aof binds by id (never creates — 17/ADR-003). The key is authored intent; the page id is the operator-supplied binding (ADR-006 — no name resolution).

oneOf.description: The m18 `boards` REGISTRY arm: a closed per-board map with a designated default (ADR-002). Multiple boards are addressable by key so two milestones can route to different boards. Closed (additionalProperties:false); there is NO top-level `parents` peer to `boards` in this arm (`parents` is per board).

default.description: REQUIRED when `boards` is present: a STRING key naming the default board (NOT a board literally keyed `default`). Must name a key present in `boards` — an Ajv-level cross-check is not expressible in plain JSON-Schema, so the runtime resolver treats an unknown `default` as the `unknown-default-board` config error; the schema only requires `default` to be a string.

boards.description: The per-board registry: each entry keyed by a board key carries that board's m17 connection fields. Closed per entry. At least one board.

additionalProperties.description: A single board's connection (the m17 shape, per board). Closed (additionalProperties:false).

dataSourceId.description: The Notion data_source_id this board's milestone + story sub-tasks live in.

tokenEnv.description: The NAME of the env var this board's integration token is read from (the token itself is never stored).

statusType.description: The Notion TYPE of this board's `statusProperty` — `status` (default) or `select`.

titleProperty.description: This board's title property name (Notion default "Name"; e.g. "Objective"). Optional.

statusMap.description: MANDATORY map: each of the four aof statuses → an EXISTING board option NAME. Closed (additionalProperties:false).

not-started.description: The board option name for the aof `not-started` status.

in-progress.description: The board option name for the aof `in-progress` status.

in-review.description: The board option name for the aof `in-review` status.

done.description: The board option name for the aof `done` status.

relationProperty.description: This board's self-relation property name a story sub-task nests through.

parents.description: OPTIONAL per-board parent map (milestone 18, ADR-001): a closed `{ <key>: <page-id> }` map binding a parent KEY to an EXISTING Notion page id, scoped to THIS board (a relation cannot cross databases).

memory.description: Work-memory backend selection (milestone 05). OPTIONAL — an absent `memory` key is equivalent to { "backend": "none" } (the graceful no-op). `backend` is an enum of the registered backend names.

backend.description: The memory backend that answers the `aof work memory` verbs. `local` = the cheap derived-index backend; `none` = a no-op so ACD runs unchanged when memory is absent; `graphify` = the graph-grounded backend (records from the 05 parsers, re-ranked by a work-stream graph built via invoke('graph:build')).
